name: browser
description: A pane that shows a web page as readable text, with its console errors and a small color preview: load a URL, follow links, reload, and hand the page to Claude. Pages are loaded with headless Chrome. Plain code while you browse: a page costs tokens only when you hand it to Claude.

agentTool.title: Let Claude open pages
agentTool.description: Give Claude a tool that loads a URL in the pane and returns the page's text and console errors.

waitMs.title: Page settle time (ms)
waitMs.description: How long headless Chrome lets a page's scripts run before the page is read.
